children: BSE Index Services, a wholly owned subsidiary of BSE, has received a Certificate of Registration from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to operate as an Index Provider under the SEBI (Index Providers) Regulations, 2024.
The registration came into effect on November 25, 2026, the company said in a media release on Thursday, November 26.

The registration marks an important milestone for the company, strengthening the institutional framework for its index-related activities and reinforcing its commitment to governance, transparency, regulatory compliance and operational excellence.
Commenting on the development, Ashutosh Singh, MD and CEO of BSE Index Services, said the registration from SEBI was a significant milestone in the company's journey.

He added that following the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) authorisation to continue administering non-significant benchmarks, the Index Provider registration further reinforces the company's commitment to the highest standards of governance, transparency and integrity in index administration.
BSE Index Services said it would continue to focus on developing credible and reliable benchmarks that contribute to market confidence and the growth of India's financial markets.
Shares of BSE Ltd. closed at ₹3,990.40 on Thursday, November 26, up ₹215.20 from the previous close of ₹3,775.20. The stock opened at ₹3,812.

BSE Index Services, formerly known as Asia Index, is a wholly owned subsidiary of BSE. The company calculates, publishes and maintains a diverse family of indices and aims to provide a range of index solutions to domestic and global investors.

title: BSE Index Services receives SEBI registration to operate as index provider
